Guideline: Use svelte/motion Spring Class for Direct Manipulation
Description: Svelte's built-in Spring motion primitive provides first-class stiffness and damping without external dependencies.
Do: Use Spring({ x: 0, y: 0 }, { stiffness: 0.18, damping: 0.65 }) for tactile drag, tilt, and scale feedback
Don't: Use linear CSS transitions for interactive pointer-driven coordinates
Code Good: const scale = new Spring(1, { stiffness: 0.25, damping: 0.55 }); // onpointerdown={() => scale.target = 0.95}
